verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list bidirectional file transfer as a core session feature alongside remote view and control. The repo also ships a cross-platform file copy-and-paste implementation (Windows, Linux, macOS). One hands-on user reports that clipboard file copy-paste from Linux to Windows doesn't work, which is a gap in one path rather than a contradiction of the dedicated transfer feature. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the file-transfer workflow and limits, independent hands-on confirmation that transfers succeed, and reliable clipboard file copy-paste across all platform pairs.

support.subject: As a power user, I can transfer files between the host and the viewing device inside a session
